description: Quote a list of companies: how many match, what the file costs, and a link that opens the order with the same list filled in. Turn the person's words into filters ("dentists in Texas" is industry Healthcare, kind dentists, state Texas). The same count and price the Engagemii order page and checkout use. Free, read only, no key: nothing is bought here. industry is one of: Technology, E-commerce, Food & Beverage, Health & Wellness, Healthcare, Beauty & Personal Care, Fashion & Apparel, Finance & Insurance, Legal, Real Estate, Travel & Hospitality, Education, Media & Entertainment, Home & Living, Pet Care, Automotive, Sports & Recreation, Professional Services, Nonprofits, Government & Public Sector, Membership Organizations, Manufacturing & Industrial, Other. kind narrows an industry to one kind of business and needs an industry; a US state makes it faster. score_band is low (0 to 3), medium (4 to 7) or high (8 to 10). scope is us (default) or all (worldwide). Without count the price is for every matching company; with count it is for that many.

count.description: Only when a number of companies is wanted. Leave it out to price every matching company.

kind.description: Optional kind of business inside the industry, matched by words in the company name, website address or page title.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code.
